paper.citation: Rahman MM et al., J Adv Vet Anim Res 2023; 10(3):570-578
paper.isolation: liver of Shing/stinging catfish (Heteropneustes fossilis), Mymensingh Bangladesh, 2021

declared_accessions.bioproject_in_paper: PRJNA810265 (WRONG - actually a Pasteurella multocida DC2020 project by same group)
declared_accessions.biosample_in_paper: SUB11126221 (submission ID, not a BioSample ID)

phylogeny_closest: A. veronii B56 (paper name; likely B565)

computed_from_actual_FASTA.delta_notes: 51bp discrepancy = trivial; likely trailing-N handling or paper reported pre-QC vs deposited version

ncbi_ani_check_best_type.assembly: GCA_001908535.1 (A. veronii bv. veronii type strain)

MLST_scheme_1_pubMLST_aeromonas.conclusion: Paper's ST 492 claim NOT reproduced. Actual assembly carries an entirely different (likely novel/unassigned) MLST profile.

abricate_AMR_CARD.vs_paper_9: Fewer than paper's 9. CARD stringency thresholds differ; some paper genes were likely chromosomal targets rather than acquired AMR.

abricate_VFDB.vs_paper_7: Paper's specialty-gene table listed 7 VFDB genes (strict PATRIC intersect); my broader BLAST-based abricate scan finds 130 hits (T3SS asc/aop operons, adhesins, hemolysins) - qualitatively consistent with paper's claim that adhesion + secretion + toxins are the dominant categories.

prophage_indication_from_PGAP.interpretation: Two contigs carry substantial prophage gene clusters (portal, terminase, capsid, tail) consistent with ~2 intact prophage regions; additional 3-gene clusters plausibly the 3rd incomplete region. Qualitatively consistent with paper's PHASTER claim of 2 intact + 1 incomplete.

ANI_to_paper_named_relatives_and_ref.note: All three references sit within ~96.2-96.5% ANI. TH0426 is NOT uniquely close - it is essentially at the same distance as B565 and FDAARGOS_632. Paper's phylogenetic 'close relationship' claim reflects tree topology (branch adjacency), not a distinctively short genome distance.

verdict_verdicts_per_claim.C7_CDS_count: APPROXIMATELY REPRODUCED (paper RAST 4229 vs PGAP 4099; ~3% difference is standard annotator-tool variance)
verdict_verdicts_per_claim.C9_rRNA_13: PARTIAL (PGAP finds 28 rRNA features - includes 16S/23S/5S fragments split across contigs since assembly is not closed; 13 may be intact-operon count)
verdict_verdicts_per_claim.C10_MLST_ST_492: CONTRADICTED (my scan of the actual deposited assembly finds 5 exact alleles - recA=1460 metG=124 gyrB=633 gltA=340 groL=91 - none of which match ST 492's expected alleles per pubMLST. Not a single profile in the entire pubMLST aeromonas database matches >=3 of my alleles. Either the paper reported the wrong ST or a different sample was submitted.)
verdict_verdicts_per_claim.C11_MDR_phenotype: SPOT-CHECK (genotype supports beta-lactam/carbapenem resistance via OXA-12 + cphA4; but the deposited genome does NOT carry an acquired tet(X), qnr, or aminoglycoside resistance gene at abricate default thresholds, so the resistance to tetracyclines/streptomycin/neomycin/ciprofloxacin observed phenotypically may be efflux/target-mediated rather than acquired-gene-mediated. Paper's genotype-phenotype linkage is not fully supported by the deposited assembly.)
verdict_verdicts_per_claim.C12_close_to_TH0426_and_B56: PARTIAL (TH0426 is within species boundary at 96.3% ANI, but so are B565 and FDAARGOS_632 at essentially the same distance. Paper's 'close relationship' is not distinguished by genome distance; may be tree-topology adjacency.)
verdict_verdicts_per_claim.C13_2_intact_1_incomplete_prophage: QUALITATIVELY REPRODUCED (PGAP annotation shows 2 contigs with dense phage gene clusters, plus several contigs with partial phage gene sets - consistent with PHASTER's 2-intact + 1-incomplete pattern; not exact re-run of PHASTER but strong indirect support)
verdict_verdicts_per_claim.C14_paper_accessions: PARTIAL (WGS JALLKR is correct; BioProject PRJNA810265 stated in paper is WRONG - it points to Pasteurella multocida DC2020 by same institution; actual BioProject is PRJNA827572)
verdict_verdicts_per_claim.C15_pathogenicity: NOT REPLICATED (wet-lab claim - could not rerun fish infection experiment; noted as unverifiable)
